queue.left_other.purpose: How many items a group still has.

item.moreTracks_other.purpose: Says how many more tracks are in the item.
item.moreTracks_other.where: Review screen, queue on the left, an item with more tracks than are named.

item.trackName.where: Review screen, queue on the left, each item, and Review screen, comparison on the right, the track column.

item.untitled.purpose: Names a track that has no title and no file name.
item.untitled.where: Review screen, queue on the left, an item's track name.

kind.versionDoubt.purpose: What kind of item it is: two tracks the rules could not tell apart or keep apart.

kind.heldSet.purpose: What kind of item it is: duplicate files held because their pairs disagree.
kind.heldSet.where: Review screen, queue on the left, under each item of that kind.

kind.sameRecording.purpose: What kind of item it is: two Library tracks that are the same recording.
kind.sameRecording.where: Review screen, queue on the left, under each item of that kind.

kind.relink.purpose: What kind of item it is: a rekordbox entry matched to a file only probably.

compare.none.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, when nothing is selected.

compare.moreDetails.purpose: Switch that adds the bitrate, sample rate and date added columns to the comparison table.
compare.moreDetails.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, above the table.

action.label.purpose: Accessible name of the group of buttons for the selected item.
action.label.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, under the table (read by screen readers).

action.dismiss.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, under the table, for a "Better file available" item.

action.keepAnyway.purpose: Button that keeps a flagged file as it is: the track leaves "Quality problems". It can be undone.
action.keepAnyway.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, under the table, for a "Quality problem" item.

action.findBetter.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, under the table, for a "Quality problem" item.

action.switch.purpose: Button that links the Library track to the suggested copy, because its linked file is gone. It can be undone.
action.switch.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, under the table, for a "File missing, copy found" item.

action.confirm.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, under the table, for a "rekordbox match uncertain" item.

action.confirmAgain.purpose: Button that confirms a relink match the user confirmed before, whose file holds other audio now.
action.confirmAgain.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, under the table, for a "rekordbox match uncertain" item whose reason is "confirmed before, the audio has changed".

action.notSame.where: Review screen, action row under the comparison, on a possible version mix-up and on Unclear duplicates with two files (with three or more, the S button is Split off).

action.rejectMatch.purpose: Button that says the file is not rekordbox's entry: the match is taken away and never made again. It can be undone.
action.rejectMatch.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, under the table, for a "rekordbox match uncertain" item.

keys.enter.purpose: Names the key that does the item's suggested action; {{action}} is the label of that button.
keys.enter.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, in the row of buttons under the table.

keys.rows.purpose: Says what the number keys do when an item has more than one copy to switch to: the digit is the row of the table.
keys.rows.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, in the row of buttons under the table.
keys.rows.approved: Number keys: switch to that row's file

accepted.line_one.purpose: Says what Accept all did (one track).
accepted.line_one.where: Review screen, line at the top, after Accept all.
accepted.line_one.approved: {{count, number}} track switched to the copy on disk

accepted.line_other.purpose: Says what Accept all did (several tracks).
accepted.line_other.where: Review screen, line at the top, after Accept all.
accepted.line_other.approved: {{count, number}} tracks switched to the copy on disk

accepted.view.purpose: Button that shows each track Accept all switched, with its old and new file.

accepted.hide.where: Review screen, line at the top, after Accept all, while the list is shown.

accepted.dismiss.purpose: Button that removes the line about Accept all.
accepted.dismiss.where: Review screen, line at the top, after Accept all.

accepted.list.purpose: Names the list of tracks Accept all switched, for screen readers.
accepted.list.where: Review screen, line at the top, the list opened with View.

accepted.col.track.purpose: Column heading: a track Accept all switched.
accepted.col.track.where: Review screen, line at the top, the list opened with View.

accepted.col.from.purpose: Column heading: the file the track was linked to before.
accepted.col.from.where: Review screen, line at the top, the list opened with View.

accepted.col.to.purpose: Column heading: the file the track is linked to now.
accepted.col.to.where: Review screen, line at the top, the list opened with View.

switch.keepsEntry.purpose: Says what switching the linked file means in rekordbox when rekordbox's entry stays the track's (the app trusts the match of that entry to the copy).
switch.keepsEntry.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, above the Switch file button, for a track rekordbox knows whose entry is matched to the copy.
switch.keepsEntry.approved: rekordbox keeps this track and its cues. It will show File is missing until you relocate the file in rekordbox.

switch.newTrack.purpose: Warns what switching the linked file means in rekordbox when the copy goes there as a new track: the cues stay on the old entry, which the user then removes by hand; relocating in rekordbox is the way to keep them.
switch.newTrack.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, above the Switch file button, for a track rekordbox knows whose entry is not matched to the copy (or only probably).
switch.newTrack.approved: rekordbox will see a new track, without the cues of the old one. The old track will be listed under Tracks to remove in rekordbox. To keep the cues, relocate the file in rekordbox instead.

switch.otherEntry.purpose: Warns what switching the linked file means in rekordbox when rekordbox holds a separate entry for the copy: the Library track is sent as that entry from then on, and the old entry is removed by hand.
switch.otherEntry.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, above the Switch file button, for a track rekordbox knows whose copy rekordbox holds as a separate track.
switch.otherEntry.approved: rekordbox already has this file as another track, and your Library track will become that one, with its cues. The old track will be listed under Tracks to remove in rekordbox. To keep the old cues, relocate the file in rekordbox instead.

held.pairOne.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, after "Why it's here:" on Unclear duplicates (a fragment naming the two files by the names the table shows).

held.pairTwo.purpose: Why an Unclear duplicates item is held: two of its files disagree, with the first two reasons the rules gave for that pair, in the words a possible version mix-up uses. Proposal.
held.pairTwo.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, after "Why it's here:" on Unclear duplicates (a fragment naming the two files by the names the table shows).

held.library.purpose: Why an Unclear duplicates item is held: two of its tracks are in the Library, and two Library tracks are never merged without a decision. Names the Library file of each. Proposal.
held.library.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, after "Why it's here:" on Unclear duplicates (a fragment).

held.keptSeparate.purpose: Why an Unclear duplicates item is held: the user said two of its tracks aren't the same. Names a file of each. Proposal.
held.keptSeparate.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, after "Why it's here:" on Unclear duplicates (a fragment).

held.linked.purpose: Why an Unclear duplicates item is held: two of its tracks are linked as versions, which are never merged. Names a file of each. Proposal.
held.linked.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, after "Why it's here:" on Unclear duplicates (a fragment).

held.tooMany.purpose: Why an Unclear duplicates item is held: it has more files, with different audio among them, than the app compares. Proposal.
held.tooMany.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, after "Why it's here:" on Unclear duplicates (a fragment with the number of files first).

error.itemGone.purpose: Says an action did nothing because the item left the queue in the meantime (answered in another step, or the files changed).
error.itemGone.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, under the action buttons, after a refused action.
error.itemGone.approved: This item has already been decided

error.noAudioKnown.purpose: Says a decision can't be stored because the file it is about has not been hashed yet.
error.noAudioKnown.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, under the action buttons, after a refused action.
error.noAudioKnown.approved: Can't do this yet: the file is still being scanned

error.switchLinkedOnDisk.purpose: Says why the linked file is not switched: it is no longer gone.
error.switchLinkedOnDisk.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, under the Switch file button (greyed out), or after a refused switch.
error.switchLinkedOnDisk.approved: Can't switch: the Library file is back on disk

error.switchNotInTrack.purpose: Says why the linked file is not switched: the copy is not one of the track's files any more.
error.switchNotInTrack.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, under the Switch file button (greyed out), or after a refused switch.
error.switchNotInTrack.approved: Can't switch: that file no longer belongs to this track

error.switchTargetGone.purpose: Says why the linked file is not switched: the copy is no longer on disk.
error.switchTargetGone.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, under the Switch file button (greyed out), or after a refused switch.
error.switchTargetGone.approved: Can't switch: the copy is missing too

error.switchTargetLinked.purpose: Says why the linked file is not switched: the copy is the linked file of another Library track.
error.switchTargetLinked.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, under the Switch file button (greyed out), or after a refused switch.
error.switchTargetLinked.approved: Can't switch: another Library track uses that file

error.switchEntryTaken.purpose: Says why the linked file is not switched: the rekordbox entry matched to the copy is the one another Library track is sent as, and that track would lose it.
error.switchEntryTaken.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, under the Switch file button (greyed out), or after a refused switch.
error.switchEntryTaken.approved: Can't switch: rekordbox's track for that file belongs to another Library track

error.switchChanged.purpose: Says the switch was not made because what it means in rekordbox is no longer what the item showed; the item is shown again with the new text.
error.switchChanged.where: Review screen, comparison on the right, under the action buttons, after a refused switch.
error.switchChanged.approved: Can't switch: this item has changed. Check it again first.

action.keepBoth.purpose: Button that keeps both Library tracks of a "Same track twice" item: they stay two tracks and the pair is not asked about again. It can be undone.
action.keepBoth.where: Review screen, "Same track twice in your Library" item, action row under the table.

action.merge.purpose: Button that opens the choice of which track stays in a merge of two Library tracks that are the same recording; the one filled button. Nothing changes until the confirmation.
action.merge.where: Review screen, "Same track twice in your Library" item, action row under the table.

action.mergeConfirm.purpose: Confirmation button that merges: the other Library track leaves the Library (undoable). Restates the verb of the question.
action.mergeConfirm.where: Review screen, "Same track twice in your Library" item, the merge confirmation, filled button.

action.goBack.purpose: Second button of the merge confirmation: closes it, nothing changes.
action.goBack.where: Review screen, "Same track twice in your Library" item, the merge confirmation.

same.label.purpose: Accessible name of the small table of the item's Library tracks (cues, rating, plays, crates).
same.label.where: Review screen, "Same track twice in your Library" item, table under the file table.

same.col.cues.purpose: Column heading: how many cues rekordbox holds for the track (hot and memory cues).
same.col.cues.where: Review screen, "Same track twice in your Library" item, Library tracks table.

same.col.rating.purpose: Column heading: the track's rating in rekordbox.
same.col.rating.where: Review screen, "Same track twice in your Library" item, Library tracks table.

same.col.plays.purpose: Column heading: the track's play count in rekordbox.
same.col.plays.where: Review screen, "Same track twice in your Library" item, Library tracks table.

same.col.crates.purpose: Column heading: how many of the app's crates hold the track.
same.col.crates.where: Review screen, "Same track twice in your Library" item, Library tracks table.

same.notInRekordbox.purpose: Says rekordbox doesn't know the track, in place of its cues, rating and plays.
same.notInRekordbox.where: Review screen, "Same track twice in your Library" item, Library tracks table, cues column.

same.noRating.purpose: The track has no rating in rekordbox.
same.noRating.where: Review screen, "Same track twice in your Library" item, Library tracks table, rating column.

same.stars_one.where: Review screen, "Same track twice in your Library" item, Library tracks table, rating column.

same.stars_other.purpose: A rating of several stars ({{count}} is 2 to 5).
same.stars_other.where: Review screen, "Same track twice in your Library" item, Library tracks table, rating column.

same.choose.purpose: Question heading the choice of which Library track stays in a merge.
same.choose.where: Review screen, "Same track twice in your Library" item, the merge confirmation, above the list of tracks.

same.suggestedTrack.purpose: A track in the merge choice that the app suggests keeping ({{name}} is "Artist - Title").
same.suggestedTrack.where: Review screen, "Same track twice in your Library" item, the merge confirmation, one choice.

same.confirm_one.purpose: Warns what a merge of two Library tracks does: the track that leaves, its files and crates, what is lost in rekordbox, the remove list, and that it can be undone.
same.confirm_one.where: Review screen, "Same track twice in your Library" item, the merge confirmation, under the choice.
same.confirm_one.approved: The other track's files and crates move to the track that stays, and it leaves your Library. Its cues, rating and plays in rekordbox won't carry over, and it will be listed under Tracks to remove in rekordbox. This action can be undone.

same.confirm_other.purpose: The same warning when several tracks leave ({{count}} is how many).
same.confirm_other.where: Review screen, "Same track twice in your Library" item, the merge confirmation, under the choice.
same.confirm_other.approved: The files and crates of the other {{count}} tracks move to the track that stays, and those tracks leave your Library. Their cues, ratings and plays in rekordbox won't carry over, and they will be listed under Tracks to remove in rekordbox. This action can be undone.

same.confirmValues_one.purpose: Warns what a merge of two Library tracks does, now that ratings, colors, comments and the user's edits can carry over (they are picked above it): the track that leaves, its files and crates, what is lost in rekordbox (cues and plays), the remove list, and that it can be undone. Replaces same.confirm_one, which says the rating won't carry over.
same.confirmValues_one.where: Review screen, "Same track twice in your Library" item, the merge confirmation, under the choices.

same.confirmValues_other.purpose: The same warning when several tracks leave ({{count}} is how many). Replaces same.confirm_other.
same.confirmValues_other.where: Review screen, "Same track twice in your Library" item, the merge confirmation, under the choices.

same.values.heading.purpose: Introduces the rows where the two tracks hold different values and the user picks which one stays (the user's edits, and rekordbox's rating, color and comments).
same.values.heading.where: Review screen, "Same track twice in your Library" item, the merge confirmation, above the table of values; shown only when some field differs.

same.values.field.purpose: Column heading: the field a row is about (Rating, Genre, ...).
same.values.field.where: Review screen, "Same track twice in your Library" item, the merge confirmation, table of values.

same.values.stays.purpose: Marks the column of the track that stays in the merge, whose values are picked at first.
same.values.stays.where: Review screen, "Same track twice in your Library" item, the merge confirmation, table of values, column heading.

same.values.use.purpose: Names one choice of a row for screen readers: {{field}} is the field, {{name}} the track whose value it keeps.
same.values.use.where: Review screen, "Same track twice in your Library" item, the merge confirmation, table of values, each radio button (read by screen readers).

keep.moreCues.purpose: Reason: the suggested track to keep has more cues in rekordbox ({{count}}) than the next one ({{other}}).
keep.moreCues.where: Review screen, "Same track twice in your Library" item, the suggestion line.
keep.moreCues.approved: more cues in rekordbox ({{count}}, the other track has {{other}})

keep.morePlays.purpose: Reason: the suggested track to keep was played more in rekordbox ({{count}} against {{other}}).
keep.morePlays.where: Review screen, "Same track twice in your Library" item, the suggestion line.
keep.morePlays.approved: played more in rekordbox ({{count}} plays, the other track has {{other}})

keep.tied.purpose: Reason: nothing separates the tracks; the older one is suggested.
keep.tied.where: Review screen, "Same track twice in your Library" item, the suggestion line.

error.mergeLinkedVersions.purpose: Refusal: two tracks of the item are linked as versions, and versions are never merged.
error.mergeLinkedVersions.where: Review screen, "Same track twice in your Library" item, under the action row after Merge.
error.mergeLinkedVersions.approved: Can't make one track: these tracks are linked as versions

keys.tracks.purpose: Says which keys work on a "Same track twice" item: a number key chooses the track of that row to stay and opens the merge confirmation.
keys.tracks.where: Review screen, "Same track twice in your Library" item, the keys line in the action row.
keys.tracks.approved: Number keys: choose the track that stays

action.sameTrack.purpose: Button that says the files of the item are one track: they are merged into the Library track (Enter does the same). Proposal.
action.sameTrack.where: Review screen, action row under the comparison, on a possible version mix-up and on Unclear duplicates; the one filled button.

action.splitOff.purpose: Button that takes the selected row's file out of its track and keeps it apart for good (S does the same). With the Library file's row selected, the other files leave it instead. Greyed out until a row is selected. Proposal.
action.splitOff.where: Review screen, action row, on a possible version mix-up and on Unclear duplicates with three or more files.

keys.s.purpose: Says what S does on this item; {{action}} is the button's own name (Not the same, or Split off). Proposal.
keys.s.where: Review screen, the keys line in the action row.

keys.selectRow.purpose: Says S needs a selected row on an item with three or more files, and what it then does. Proposal.
keys.selectRow.where: Review screen, the keys line in the action row, while no row is selected.

error.sameAudio.purpose: Why a split was refused: the file holds the very same audio as a file it would leave, and such files are always one track. Proposal.
error.sameAudio.where: Review screen, under the action row, after Split off or S.
error.sameAudio.approved: Can't split: these files hold the same audio

error.splitTwoLibraryTracks.purpose: Why a split was refused: the selected file's identical copies, which go along with it, are the linked files of two Library tracks, and a split never makes two Library tracks one. Proposal (1bF-2).
error.splitTwoLibraryTracks.where: Review screen, under the action row, after Split off or S.
